description: Pause or resume a linked store. A paused connector is skipped by the cycle and by execution. connector_id is the id from list_commerce_connectors. Needs the owner or admin role and a Last Price credential with commerce configure scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

active.description: true to resume, false to pause.

connector_id.description: The connector id, as list_commerce_connectors gives it.

name: set_commerce_connector_active
